name: Visual Commonsense Reasoning (VCR)
description: Visual Commonsense Reasoning (VCR) is a large-scale visual reasoning dataset that challenges models to answer complex questions about movie scenes and provide valid natural language rationales justifying their answers ($Q \to A \to R$). Drawn from 110,000 movie frames across 290,000 questions, answering requires commonsense knowledge about social interactions, human intent, and physical scene dynamics grounded in object bounding boxes.
